Sunnyside Park homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Sunnyside Park, October 2026. Detached houses: 44 listed at month end and 11 sold in October, a sales ratio of 25% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 22 listed at month end and 8 sold in October, a sales ratio of 36% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 29 sold over 5 months against an average of 47.2 listed, about 8.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was October with 11 sold. Condos and townhomes: 43 sold over 5 months against an average of 33.4 listed, about 3.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 11 sold.

faq.q: Which secondary school is in this area?
faq.a: Semiahmoo Secondary is at 1785 - 148 Street, Surrey, on its SD36 page, and the district locator confirms it serves that address (elementary: H. T. Thrift Elementary) (SD36 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01); catchment for any other specific address must be checked in the Surrey Schools School Locator.

faq.q: What recreation is in the sub-area?
faq.a: Bakerview Park has Sunnyside Community Hall, a garden, playground, baseball diamonds and a soccer field; Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest offers about 4 km of trails; and the South Surrey Recreation and Arts Centre is at 14601 - 20 Ave.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Sunnyside Park?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 44 houses listed with 11 sold in the month and 22 condos and townhomes listed with 8 sold in the month in Sunnyside Park. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sunnyside Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 25%, a sellers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 36%, a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
